grouped_generic_method.source: struct P{}impl P{pub fn id<T>(self,x:T)->T{return x;}}fn main()->i32{let p=P{};let n:u8=(p.id)(255);printf("%ld\n",n);return 0;}

nested_generic_context.source: struct Box<T>{pub v:T,}struct S{pub b:Box<Box<[u8;2]>>,}fn main()->i32{let s=S{b:Box{v:Box{v:[1,255]}}};printf("%ld\n",s.b.v.v[1]);return 0;}

generic_enum_argument.source: enum E<T>{One(T),None,}fn read<T>(e:E<T>,fallback:T)->T{return match e {One(x)->x;None->fallback;};}fn main()->i32{let n:u8=read(E.One(255 as u8),0 as u8);printf("%ld\n",n);return 0;}

nested_pattern_enum_object.source: enum E{One(u8),}struct P{pub a:[E;1],}fn main()->i32{let p=P{a:[E.One(255)]};let n:u8=match p {{a:[One(x)]}->x;*->0;};printf("%ld\n",n);return 0;}

match_effect_statement.source: fn effect()->bool{printf("effect\n");return true;}fn main()->i32{let n:u8=match true {true->{effect();255;}false->0;};printf("%ld\n",n);return 0;}

specialization_identity.source: fn id<T>(x:T)->T{return x;}fn wrap<T>(x:T)->(T,){return (id(x),);}fn main()->i32{let a:(u8,)=wrap(255 as u8);let b:(f32,)=wrap(1.5 as f32);printf("%ld %.1f\n",a.0,b.0);return 0;}
